primitiveLeafEvidence.limitation: Primitive list is a named-leaf sample proxy; inlined primitives can be charged elsewhere. Family exposure matches named checker-body/pure ancestors and measures synchronous sampled descendant work only; CPS resumes sever logical operation ancestry, categories can overlap, and none is whole-operation time.

findings.text: Map.get.go4115.680ms self and index_lookup.find.go4019.368ms self are strongest named synchronous algorithms. Whole Map-family leaves total8146.248ms, index/scope leaves5289.124ms. Map.get.go leading consumer chain is checker_body_arena_names_cons -> checker_pure_arena_name -> checker_arena.name -> Map.get -> Map.get.go:1250.593ms leaf samples in that chain. Other chains resume checker_continuation_696(391.529ms) and3017(244.801ms). Source checker_arena.name accesses name_ids using Map.get and rebuilds an Arena record; this is actual name interning, not an arithmetic primitive.

index_lookup.find.go has1011.229ms samples under scope_lookup.lookup and359.606ms under scope_lookup.equal_names -> equal_names_result -> canonical_name -> lookup, called by checker_body_whnf_pattern_constructor via continuation387. This specifically connects canonical-name resolution to weak-head pattern matching.

Primitive-like named leaf samples total1429.723ms, including String.from_list262.811ms, Map.bit181.358ms, Char.is_eq167.829ms, String.cmp120.506ms and String.eq92.174ms. These are JavaScript native/intrinsic implementation leaf attributions, not a measurement of all primitive work; V8 inlining may charge callers. Map.bit is a codePointAt-based intrinsic while Map.get.go/index traversal remain generated structured algorithms.

CPS host frames total19234.865ms self(19.719%); runCheckerSteps9851.210ms and runSteps9149.042ms lead. Generated runtime/primitive helper lexical leaves13379.858ms. GC5736.904ms(5.881%). runCheckerSteps is a one-line delegating wrapper, so self attribution includes optimization/inlining effects; subtracting these numbers does not predict a removable scheduler cost or speedup.

Substitution is visible at checker_body_core_subst_at67.725ms self, subst_memo_get159.642ms, subst_memo_put69.512ms and rewind.subst_memo.loop177.946ms. get_node consumers include whnf and core_subst_open. Source32706 emits CheckerDirect whose invoke calls subst_memo_get; samples then show anonymous closure -> runSteps without original logical caller. Source15765 emits CheckerPending(core_subst) from TermSub evaluation. Thus CPS breaks synchronous ancestry; small named substitution/derive self samples are NOT evidence those logical operations are cheap.

Most concrete larger investigation target is repeated name interning/canonical-name resolution at arena_names_cons and WHNF pattern matching, not merely tweaking Map.bit or primitive arithmetic. Profile establishes those consumers are hot but does not prove which representation redesign wins, nor support an8x claim. Logical type/substitution attribution needs counts or operation-aware tracing; this profile cannot recover it by subtracting generic helpers.
